basic_info.description: Experience luxury living at Arden! This unique corner home features one of the most spacious 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom floor plans in the building, perfect for entertaining with separate dining and living areas,  premium finishes throughout, including Thermador appliances, wide-plank wood floors, a balcony, an XL wraparound terrace, an expansive dining area, and a versatile open floor plan. The expensive primary suite boasts an extra large walk-in closet finished with California Closet organizers and a luxurious en-suite bathroom with a double sink vanity, a walk-in shower stall, and a separate tub. Floor-to-ceiling windows beautifully showcase the exceptional private wraparound terrace, offering breathtaking views of the city, Bay Bridge, Twin Peaks, and Sutro Tower. Parking with an EV charger and additional storage are included. Amenities include two hotel-inspired lobby lounges, a 75' pool and spa accompanied by a glass-enclosed fitness center, as well as a beautiful open-air deck featuring a grilling and a fireside gathering area. Arden is located in the vibrant Mission Bay neighborhood and just a short walk to Chase Center, Oracle Park, Social Sparks, tech HQs, cafes and restaurants, MUNI, Caltrain, I280, and the UCSF campus.
